name: 56374 · St Joseph, MN
findings: ZIP 56374 (St Joseph) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 56374 (St Joseph) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 56374 (St Joseph) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 38% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.
